content: {"paper_id":"lab-df79e6b90766","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"In partial label learning (PLL), each training sample is associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one is valid.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文明确以偏标记学习为任务：每个训练样本有候选标签集且仅一个为真，核心是消歧。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"In partial label learning (PLL), each training sample is associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one is valid.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"候选标签集替代唯一真值、仅一个有效，属于不完整或不精确监督，且论文以该监督条件为核心研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"Besides, we assume the feature space and the label space share the same local topological structure captured by a dynamic graph, and use it to assist disambiguation.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"假设特征空间与标签空间共享由动态图刻画的局部拓扑结构，并用该图辅助消歧，属于以图结构施加几何一致性约束的图或流形正则化。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","reason_zh":"摘要提到动态图刻画局部拓扑结构，但未明确说明是否学习或修正样本间边、邻接或亲和矩阵，无法确定满足图结构学习定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
